video_title: Why the Knicks Must Keep Their Core, Plus Wemby & Dylan Harper | Cousins

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's defensive impact and offensive growth potential
quotes.excerpt: Defensively, he's what we've never seen on the defensive end. The impact that he has, we've never seen that.
quotes.quote: Defensively, he's what we've never seen on the defensive end. The impact that he has, we've never seen that. Offensively, he has a lot of growth because he's not strong. He really doesn't know who he is as an offensive player and what he can do consistently and how he can be effective on the offensive end consistently. We're seeing him go and play around the basket, but again, he's 7'4", he's not as strong as some of the guys that are guarding him. They're beating him up, they're wearing him down. In that aspect, that's where he has to play, but he has to get stronger to play there.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama needs core strength to handle physical play
quotes.excerpt: I think it's more core strength. You can just see him falling off, getting bumped.
quotes.quote: I think it's more core strength. You can just see him falling off, getting bumped. And that was the proper strategy in my opinion. You have to be physical because if you allow him to move freely and get to his spots, once he gets to his pull-up or jump hook or whatever he wants to do, you can't do nothing with that. So I think it's going to take care of itself, him being motivated enough to get better at all aspects because I think his growth leading to this year has been tenfold.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper's potential as a secondary closer for the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: I think Dylan Harper will be the one-two punch of closers.
quotes.quote: I think Dylan Harper will be the one-two punch of closers. So when Jalen Brunson is not having his moment against a player, his night or whatever, you have another guy that can go get it done. He can always be your number one closer. I feel like he can be that guy and they can share the wealth there, but Dylan Harper, I think it's time to have this talk.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox needs a starting role next season
quotes.excerpt: He's got to start. I don't give a flip, that kid has to start.
quotes.quote: He's got to start. I don't give a flip, that kid has to start. Ain't no coming off the bench, bro. That kid has to have a starting job next year for San Antonio. I'm not saying Fox has to go, but he's got to come off of that starting point guard job. He has to. It ain't no if, ands, or buts about it. You either got to get off of that contract or you got to figure something out. That young fellow has to be starting. Ain't no way he's coming off your bench next year and playing bench minutes.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks must keep their core group together
quotes.excerpt: It's a no-brainer to me. You keep that group together.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Cat is eligible for an extension, four years, 272 million is available. What are your thoughts on that, and do you think the Knicks need to keep Cat and Brunson together?

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: Yeah, keep them together because we now know what that looks like as a duo, the pick-and-roll. We know what it looks like when you're featuring Jalen Brunson. We know what it looks like when you allow Cat to be the feature and the playmaker where Brunson gets to play off the ball, and now it led to a championship. It's a no-brainer to me. You keep that group together.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Mike Brown's adjustment made the championship possible
quotes.excerpt: If it wasn't for Mike Brown making that adjustment, we won't be having this discussion.
quotes.quote: If it wasn't for Mike Brown making that adjustment, making Cat a focal point of the offense along with Brunson, we won't be having this discussion of them being a world champion. So you got to reward him for that. He was an integral part of them winning the championship, not just think you got to run that back. You don't want to break that out because we've seen when teams have made it to the finals, I'm not saying teams that won it, but obviously New York won it, but we've seen teams that made it to the finals and start making these adjustments and they haven't seen the finals again.
